valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E on the NYSE listing. The NYSE-listed security is the UBS Group AG ordinary share (ADR ratio 1:1, no ratio conversion), and UBS reports in USD, so no FX conversion is needed. A bank, so P/TBV is the cross-check: tangible book value per share was $27.00 at 30 Sept 2026 (3Q26 release). EPS basis: 9M26 diluted EPS of $2.66 (3Q26 $0.85, net profit $2,690m, implying about 3.16bn diluted shares, our arithmetic) plus an assumed 4Q26 of about $0.85 gives FY26 about $3.50 (our estimate). Targets use FY2027 EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027).

bear.driver: Swiss capital rules on foreign subsidiaries force extra CET1 or curb buybacks, investment banking normalises and integration costs persist; EPS falls below the FY26 run-rate and the multiple de-rates
bear.assumption: EPS $3.30 at 11x (about 1.3x TBV on roughly $28 TBV)

base.driver: Cost savings reach about $13.7bn gross by end-2026 (company target), underlying RoCET1 stays above the ~15% exit-rate target, buybacks continue at a ~14% CET1 ratio; EPS grows about 11% from FY26
base.assumption: EPS $3.90 at 13x (about 1.7x TBV on roughly $30 TBV)

bull.driver: Capital rules settle benignly, wealth management and investment banking outperform and capital returns step up; EPS about 29% above FY26 and the multiple re-rates

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $3.90 the close of $48.31 implies about 12.4x FY2027 EPS, or about 1.8x reported TBV of $27.00. The few aggregator consensus snapshots found (Yahoo Finance average about $55 on Oct 22; MarketBeat $60.30 in May, possibly stale) imply about 14x to 15.5x our base EPS or EPS of about $4.2 to $4.6 at 13x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.90 (about 8.1 percentage points of price return on the close). A $0.10 change in FY2027 EPS moves it by $1.30 (about 2.7 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Underlying RoCET1 versus the ~15% exit-rate target and the CET1 ratio versus ~14%, together with the Swiss Parliament outcome on capitalising foreign subsidiaries, which sets buyback capacity.
valuation.next_disclosure: 4Q26 and FY2026 results in February 2027 (exact date not confirmed in sources reviewed), where UBS will give its 2027 capital return ambitions.

analyst_notes: Only one named, dated call on UBS could be verified: Joseph Dickerson (Jefferies) reiterated Buy on 2026-06-18 with a CHF 60 target (not entered because it is in CHF and its horizon is undocumented). Firm-level actions seen only on aggregator pages without a named analyst (Barclays upgrade to Equal-Weight on 2026-04-20, Morgan Stanley Underweight and Citigroup Neutral reaffirmed in July 2026, KBW downgrade to a moderate sell) are excluded. No named target on the USD listing was found, and the Q3 earnings release was on 2026-10-28; the earnings_at time was not verified, so it is null.
